name: Dunes
description: A sand sea flown at low altitude: long crests bent by noise, ridged slip faces along the tops, and wind ripples crawling over the whole thing. A low sun rakes across it and the dunes shadow each other, which is what gives the field its scale.

relief.description: Height of the dunes. Past about 1.6 the slip faces start to overhang the march.

ripples.description: Wind ripples crawling across the sand.

haze.description: Distance haze — how far into the field you can see.

sun.description: Sun height. Low is long shadows; high flattens the field out.
